status: AUTHOR ONLY. No compile/link, decoder, solver, source modification, Git or SHA action.
CLI: --read check|check_release|extended CPU|GPU DATA FRESHOUT; compile this one profile by absolute source path. check admits only outputs/upl_prestress_check_{CPU,GPU}_r1/data; check_release admits CPU only at outputs/upl_prestress_check_release_CPU_r1/data; extended admits only outputs/upl_prestress_extended_{CPU,GPU}_r1/data. check_release is the same physical input/window in an actual ReleaseCPU execution for fair backend timing, not a new physical candidate or half test. The extended input seed name is CaseLianSaturatedColumnCollapse_prestress_gravity_r1 under outputs/upl_prestress_gravity_r1_seed; the reader never confuses this seed stem with the output run tag.
clock_and_samples: All windows use the actual binary64 parsed/literal decimal Dt=.0000025. check and check_release each declare400 updates/end.001/output.0001; extended declares2000000 updates/end5/output.01. Read actual completed Run.csv Steps and PartFiles; require the declared target update count or one additional update, enumerate every contiguous native Part file, and use that actual frame count in the new export header. No11/501-frame or fixed40/4000-save-step assumption. Every saved native Step is retained verbatim; noninitial completed=Step+1 must strictly increase and end at actual Run Steps. Compute the reference clock only by scalar+=Dt for every completed update between saves; compare actual native TimeStep within1e-14s. No n*dt substitution, frame relabelling or interpolation. Final observed native time must be within one Dt of the declared end and never beyond end+Dt+1e-14. Output interval is reported as the owner-declared setting, not a fabricated native scheduling proof.
initial_p0_and_fields: Reuse the closed7060-ID initial coordinates from outputs/upl_c08_global_CPU_r1/ids.csv. For every original soil and fixed ID, expected P0=float(1000*double(float(9.81))*(2-z0)); all stored P0 bits must remain equal in every frame. Fixed samples above H2 retain the negative affine baseline. All initial effective stress and kappa are zero; physical soil is at rest with exact J1/n0/theta0/reference-density. Initial soil p equals its stored P0 except actual FSType2/3 finite positive pressure is zero, so the top initial native excess is about-196Pa. Verify this actual mask/field relationship instead of requiring p0 or excess0. Subsequent fixed pressure is reconstructed and is NOT required to equal its P0. Reader never rewrites pressure, baseline or metadata.
unchanged_original_guards: Neutral BI4 parser and public22 typed arrays remain unchanged:7060 native IDs=5000soil+2060fixed, original constants/kernel/mass, no exclusions or periodic/dynamic ownership, all22 fields finite and ID-aligned, native double stress with exact float display rounding, same-J n/V/rho/k ledger, native float Rhop cache, original fixed-marker and geometry/rest checks, nonnegative and nondecreasing physical-soil kappa by native ID, nonempty actual FSType2/3 in every frame with p<=0, typed free-seepage/MR1/decay0 metadata and signed nonempty dterror<=1e-14 in every noninitial saved interval. Initial dterror retains its original sentinel policy. Zero kappa at the end remains allowed. No half/backend/theory/equilibrium or energy/water-mass gate is introduced.
outputs_and_cost: Write typed22.bin(212bytes/ID plus original per-frame native time), typed22_layout.csv, clocks.csv, native_ids.csv with the immutable baseline P0 and five initial-material-band history rows per frame. Keep all actual raw typed fields but OMIT the old large per-ID derived ledger.csv; execute and count every ledger/fixed/cache/P0/history check directly. New completion names these as checks rather than claiming written ledger rows. History appends actual native excess mean/RMS/min/max without removing negative values; all prior pressure/stress/settlement/velocity/J/n/energy descriptive columns remain. The initial material bands remain based on the retained native-coordinate extrema, as in the prior reader.
proof_limits: The backend argument and matched directory are profile identity, not hardware proof; actual tool/solver ownership, normal exits, input/source/program bindings and the damping.02/Shepard40/ConstantZ H2 settings must be verified by the outer reviewed run receipts. The raw public schema lacks CODE, complete Ace and wall reaction; no active-wall count, exact flux, equilibrium, prestress convergence, restart interoperability or plastic-wall acceptance is inferred. Completed dyadic tests and native exports remain untouched.
